generate_api_key_for_models: generate an API key scoped to specific models via the litellm proxy key/generate endpoint
get_available_models: get the list of models a user has access to via the litellm proxy /models endpoint
add_model_to_proxy: add a new model to the litellm proxy with custom litellm params and optional team assignment
delete_model_from_proxy: delete a model from the litellm proxy by its model ID via the /model/delete endpoint
check_model_health: check the health status of a specific model endpoint via the litellm proxy /health endpoint
